data.title: One small leap for a muscle, one giant step for robotics
data.description: These robots have real muscles, and they’re finally making big moves. Researchers at ETH Zurich have developed muscle actuators that flex strongly enough to enable small robots to jump, swim, walk and grasp.
data.keywords: Digital fabrication, Mechanical engineering, Biotechnology, News, Materials science, Engineering sciences, D-MAVT, Biology
